description.value: The Edge Social Grille & Lounge is the on-site restaurant of the Best Western Premier Chateau Granville Hotel, situated on the Granville Street side of the hotel in the heart of Vancouver's Entertainment District. It serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner daily, with a full bar featuring BC wines by the glass and a menu of locally sourced Canadian dishes. The outdoor seating faces Granville Street, placing it in the middle of one of downtown Vancouver's busiest pedestrian corridors.
